text: {"lessons":["My account fell over several periods, so I should expect short-term volatility and avoid making decisions based on fear or a single month’s return.","I made no trades during the first four periods, then bought Stock A and Stock E; I should make future trades deliberately, based on a clear plan rather than trying to time a rebound.","Because I’m investing toward an apartment within ten years, I should balance growth with diversification and keep enough cash for flexibility instead of concentrating my savings in a few stocks."]}
